items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I knew Snow Fisher very well, he was famous in his day.

ctx.x: He was an expert strutter and cake-walker. I knew Snow Fisher very well, he was famous in his day. He was a goodlooking kid, you know, real, real dark. Real fine dresser. He dressed -- he was one of the best dressers of all male entertainers, during his time.
